title: Few-shot-routed function-vector experts without weight experts
hypothesis: On 16 held-out Pythia-70M relation tasks, a router that reads the few-shot demonstration context can select support-derived residual-stream function-vector experts with at least 0.75 task-route accuracy, and the routed activation experts will retain task quality within 0.05 candidate accuracy and 0.10 gold-logprob nats of oracle FV routing while costing at most 0.75x the complete learned-router rank-one MLP-output expert bank.
mirror_coordinate: A task address selects one support-derived additive residual-stream function vector at layer 3 query-final position; router uses the complete few-shot prompt context.
logical_multiplicity: Sixteen relation-task activation experts, top-1 routed per query. Task-count is coverage, not independent capacity.
controls: No activation intervention with the same four-shot prompt (native ICL baseline)
Oracle-task-routed explicit FP32 FV bank (conditional quality upper)
Learned-router rank-one task-specific MLP-output LoRA residual bank fitted from support activation pairs (weight-space control)
Shared mean FV with no routing (shared behavior control)

task.source: Frozen 16 relation tasks and split routine copied from MA-530 shared_fv_harness.py.
task.router_context: Four fixed support demonstrations in task order, then query; no answer from query is included.
task.fv_extraction: Mean layer-3 residual hidden-state difference at query-final position between prompt with all other seven support demonstrations and the same query without demonstrations.
task.primary_metric: Held-out candidate accuracy over all task queries

router.input: Layer-4 final hidden state at the query-final position with four support demonstrations.
router.fit_data: Eight support queries per task on development seeds only; support/query inputs disjoint.
router.architecture: Single affine 512-to-16 softmax classifier; standardization mean/std and weights/bias stored FP32; argmax top-1.
router.optimization: Full-batch cross-entropy Adam, lr=.01, exactly 1000 updates, zero weight decay. Fixed, no tuning. If it cannot fit or route, record that result.
router.context_demonstrations: Select the first four support rows under split order for each routed example; support prompt includes query input removed from demo list if duplicated.

weight_control.insertion: Per-task rank-one LoRA residual on layer-3 MLP output: y += (x @ A) @ B, rank 1.
weight_control.fit: Use support examples only; regress observed layer-3 MLP inputs to target residual-stream FV deltas with ridge=1e-3, take best rank-one SVD approximation. Same learned router addresses the task-specific factors.
weight_control.cost: Store all A/B factors, router, normalization and metadata; report fit/decode compute.

development.selection_metric: Mean accuracy, then gold log probability; there are no tunable hyperparameters.

fresh.opening_rule: Open only if both development seeds pass route, FV-vs-oracle quality, and FV-vs-LoRA byte gates.

storage.authority: Actual uncompressed NPZ serialized inference payload bytes.
paid_objects: task ids, model revision, layer and schema metadata
pinned model files for standalone deployment
storage.reporting: Expert-only, router+expert, incremental-over-preloaded-model, and standalone Pythia deployment totals; serialize independently for each method.

compute.active_compute_proxy: Report candidate transformer sequences/tokens, affine route MACs, FV add dimensions, LoRA rank-one MACs, extraction/ridge fit work, and isolated extraction/evaluation wall time.

success_gate: Both development seeds: learned router route accuracy >=.75; learned-router FV is within .05 accuracy and .10 gold-logprob nats of oracle FV; complete learned-router FV payload <=.75x the same-router rank-one weight bank; and FV improves over ICL by >=.05 accuracy or >=.10 gold-logprob nats on average. Fresh remains unopened until all gates pass.
failure_gate: Any development seed misses route/quality/byte gate, or the intervention has no consistent held-out gain over ICL. Exact/native-control ties count against Mirror-specific attribution.
boundaries: One pinned Pythia-70M model and 16 relation tasks.
This is a few-shot contextual routing test, distinct from MA-530 query-only routing.
Support-derived FV extraction has support examples available at task setup; no fresh query labels are used.
Task label routing is not independent expert capacity.
No general language-model, scaling, or capacity claim.
